disagreements.question: Where is the highest section of Victoria?
disagreements.answer: The highest section of Victoria is the Victorian Alps in the northeast, which are part of the Great Dividing Range mountain system. The Alps are the coldest part of Victoria, with average temperatures less than 9 °C (48 °F) in winter and below 0 °C (32 °F) in the highest parts of the ranges. The state's lowest minimum temperature of −11.7 °C (10.9 °F) was recorded at Omeo on 13 June 1965, and again at Falls Creek on 3 July 1970. [2] [3] [4] [5]
